The observed times (in minutes) it takes a runner to complete a marathon are normally distributed. The z-score for his running time this week is –2. Which one of the following statements is a correct interpretation of his z-score?
Option A: This week his time was two minutes lower than his time last week.
Option B: This week his time was two minutes lower than his best time ever.
Option C: This week his time was two minutes lower than his average time.
Option D: This week his time was two standard deviations lower than his average time.
